Open [index.html](./index.html) to use the offline rehearsal scheduler. It starts with a valid recurring booking for each of the four groups.

Select a booking to move or unplace it. The editor identifies conflicts with group availability, room capacity, piano access, operating hours, and overlapping rehearsals. Changes are saved in the current browser. **Print schedule** produces a weekly sheet covering both rooms and all five weekdays.

I verified booking changes, conflict handling, save-and-reload behavior, and print content. The print layout was not visually previewed.
